limitations: Native artifact omits executable binaries and build caches. Recorded executable SHA256 values cannot be independently recomputed from this archive.

Local partial clone lacks the recorded merge object. Merge identity and parents, the merged recognizer, and the pinned original Filter were independently fetched from GitHub; other source inputs match the reviewed branch and the archived compiled bytes.

Native host is a virtual Apple M1 with no recorded CPU affinity; Linux is a pinned logical Xeon CPU with another compiler, runtime and locale. No cross-platform absolute timing or allocation extrapolation.
Large native cases calibrate to one operation per process. Six pairs have substantial host/run variance and are not individual UI latency percentiles.
All completed observations, including unfavorable and high-variance records, are retained. No outlier deletion or benchmark rerun was performed in this audit.

predeclared_replication_plan.decision_timing: After auditing the first Linux cohort and observing the first native cohort, before the requested native replication begins.
predeclared_replication_plan.reason: The first native cohort has substantial paired variability and mixed controls. The primary 100k/depth2 broad search has only3/6 faster pairs and a near-zero median paired reduction despite different separate medians. One independent identical native run will assess repeatability.
predeclared_replication_plan.reporting: Retain and report both native cohorts separately and all raw records. Summarize consistency over the12 within-run pairs without pairing different runs or mixing platforms. Do not discard observations or continue repeating until a favorable result appears.

ci_merge_recognizer_distinction.resolution: Six initial source-receipt comparisons (four tests and two builds) compared the newer-main CI merge helper against the older unmerged branch. Exact merge source and commit parents were independently fetched from GitHub. Both native variants and Linux variants use the same authenticated merge helper. There is no baseline/candidate helper difference.

reporting_recommendations: Use paired reduction and faster-pair counts as the primary paired comparison; label separate baseline/candidate medians as marginal medians.
For search/100000/2/broad, paired wall median is effectively zero with three faster and three slower pairs; do not claim the 8.81% ratio of separate medians as a demonstrated native speedup.
Report positive small-tree, deep-tree, Unicode and nested-projection observations alongside flat-projection and other negative/mixed controls.
Linux allocation-request reductions are directly measured only on Linux/glibc, not native macOS allocation or retained-memory evidence.

Retain this original native cohort and the one predeclared identical native repetition separately. Show both regardless of outcome. Any pooled 12-pair statistic is secondary, must include all observations, and must not hide disagreement.
Do not aggregate heterogeneous cases into one player or UI speedup. Component correctness qualification and workload-dependent component timings are the supported claims.
scope: Independent artifact, source, test, pair-order, command-output and numerical-summary audit. No benchmarks rerun.
